about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Burritos with Black Beans and Cheese
recipes.summary: Scrambled egg, black beans and cheese rolled in tortillas, wrapped and frozen for quick reheating.
steps: Fry the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then add the beans and cumin and cook for 2 minutes until warmed through.
Whisk the eggs with the salt, pour into the pan and stir gently for 3 minutes until just set and no liquid egg remains.
Cool the filling for 15 minutes, stir in the cheese, divide among the tortillas, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wrap each burrito in baking paper and freeze for up to 2 months.
To reheat, microwave one from frozen for 2 minutes then turn and heat for 1 to 2 minutes more until steaming hot throughout.
notes: Cool the filling before wrapping or the tortillas go soggy.
Food safety: cook eggs until fully set, cool burritos within 2 hours before freezing and reheat until steaming hot (at least 75°C).

recipes.title: Make-Ahead Egg and Spinach Muffin Cups
recipes.summary: Baked egg cups with spinach and cheese that keep all week in the fridge.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and brush a 12-hole muffin tin lightly with the oil.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper, then stir in the spinach, onion and cheese.
Pour into the tin holes about three-quarters full and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until puffed and set in the centre.
notes: Cool completely before storing in an airtight box.
Food safety: bake until the centres are firm, refrigerate within 2 hours, eat within 4 days and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Cold-Soaked Oats with Grated Apple, Walnuts and Honey
recipes.summary: Creamy cold oats softened in milk and yoghurt with grated apple and a hint of cinnamon.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt, apple, cinnamon, and honey together in a jar or bowl until combined.
Cover and chill in the fridge overnight until the oats are soft and the mixture is thick.
Stir, loosen with a splash of milk if needed and top with the walnuts.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
Use any grated firm fruit in place of the apple.

recipes.title: Baked Apple and Walnut Oatmeal Squares
recipes.summary: Chewy baked oat squares with apple and cinnamon, cut up for the week ahead.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Mix the oats, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and half the apple and walnuts in a bowl.
Whisk the eggs, milk, maple syrup, vanilla and butter, pour over the oats and stir, then tip into the tin and top with the remaining apple and walnuts.
Bake for 30 minutes until golden and the centre is firm.
notes: Cut into squares once cool for neat edges.
Food safety: bake until set in the centre, refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 4 days.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Soaked Oat Jars
recipes.summary: Coconut-milk soaked oats layered with fresh mango, set in jars overnight.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, coconut milk, honey and vanilla together.
Cover and chill for at least 4 hours or overnight until the oats are soft and the mixture is thick.
Mix the mango with the lime juice, then spoon the pudding and mango into jars in layers and finish with the coconut.
notes: Stir once more before layering for a creamy texture.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Freezer Wholemeal Pancakes
recipes.summary: Fluffy wholemeal pancakes cooked in batches and frozen between sheets of baking paper.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar and salt, then add the eggs, milk, butter and vanilla and stir until just combined with a few small lumps.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil over medium heat, pour in about 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear and the edges set.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Cool, stack between baking paper and freeze for up to 2 months; reheat in the toaster until hot.
notes: Do not overmix the batter or the pancakes turn tough.
Food safety: cook until no wet batter remains, cool within 2 hours before freezing and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Savoury Corn and Cheddar Breakfast Muffins
recipes.summary: Tender cornmeal muffins with sweetcorn, cheddar and chives for a grab-and-go breakfast.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and line a 6-hole muffin tin.
Stir the flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt in a bowl, whisk the eggs, milk and oil together and fold into the dry mix until just combined, then fold in the corn, cheese and chives.
Spoon into the cases and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Best warm, split and spread with butter.
Food safety: bake until a skewer comes out clean, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Egg Bake with Chives
recipes.summary: A high-protein baked egg and cottage cheese dish, sliced like a frittata.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 20cm baking dish with the oil.
Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, zucchini, chives, salt and pepper until combined.
Pour into the dish, scatter with the cheddar and bake for 28 to 30 minutes until puffed, golden and set in the centre.
notes: Squeeze the grated zucchini in a cloth first so the bake stays firm.
Food safety: bake until the centre is firm and fully set, then refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: High-Protein Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Nuts and Honey
recipes.summary: Thick Greek yoghurt with toasted nuts, seeds and honey for a quick protein-rich start.
steps: Toast the almonds and pumpkin seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until golden and fragrant, then cool briefly.
Dice the apple and spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with the apple and toasted nuts, drizzle with the honey and dust with cinnamon.
notes: Add a handful of rolled oats for extra fibre.
Swap in any fruit that is in season.

recipes.title: Lentil and Egg Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Crisp potato and lentil hash topped with fried eggs, smoky paprika and fresh parsley.
steps: Cook the potato in a wide pan with the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and tender.
Add the onion and paprika and cook for 3 minutes until soft, then stir in the lentils and salt and cook for 3 minutes until hot and crisp in places.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set, then top with the parsley.
notes: Use pre-cooked potato to save time.
Food safety: cook until the egg whites are fully set.

recipes.title: Edamame and Avocado Toast with Lime
recipes.summary: Smashed edamame and avocado piled on seeded toast with chilli and lime.
steps: Simmer the edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes until tender, then drain.
Mash the edamame roughly with the avocado, lime juice and salt, leaving some texture.
Toast the bread until crisp and golden, spread with the mixture and finish with chilli, sesame and spring onion.
notes: Add a poached egg for extra protein.
Eat soon after making as avocado browns.

recipes.title: Lentil Salad with Roast Carrots and Tahini
recipes.summary: Warm roast carrots on lentils with a lemony tahini dressing and parsley.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C, toss the carrots with the oil, cumin and a pinch of salt and roast for 25 minutes until tender and caramelised.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and salt until smooth and pourable.
Toss the lentils with the red onion and parsley, top with the warm carrots and drizzle with the dressing.
notes: Serve warm or at room temperature.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge without the parsley.

recipes.title: Chickpea Tabbouleh with Mint and Lemon
recipes.summary: Herb-heavy tabbouleh bulked up with chickpeas and a little fine bulgur.
steps: Soak the bulgur in 100ml boiling water for 10 minutes until tender, then drain well.
Toss the herbs, tomatoes, cucumber, spring onions and chickpeas together.
Mix in the bulgur, lemon juice, olive oil and salt and toss again until everything is glossy.
notes: Chop the herbs finely with a sharp knife so they stay fresh.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Bulgur and Tomato Kisir with Pomegranate Molasses
recipes.summary: A Turkish bulgur salad with tomato paste, parsley and tangy pomegranate molasses.
steps: Pour the boiling water over the bulgur and tomato paste, stir, cover and let stand for 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the water is absorbed.
Mix in the molasses, oil, lemon juice, chilli and salt.
Fold in the spring onions, herbs and tomatoes and serve in lettuce leaves.
notes: Pomegranate molasses can be replaced with an extra splash of lemon juice.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Warm Kale Salad with Roast Sweet Potato and Pepitas
recipes.summary: Roast sweet potato on massaged kale with toasted pepitas and a maple mustard dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C, toss the sweet potato with 1 tbsp oil, paprika and a pinch of salt and roast for 25 minutes until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Whisk the remaining oil, lemon juice, mustard, maple and salt together, then massage into the kale for 2 minutes until softened.
Toss the kale with the warm sweet potato, scatter with the pepitas and feta and serve.
notes: Massaging the kale takes away the bitterness.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Roast Cauliflower Salad with Tahini and Raisins
recipes.summary: Spiced roast cauliflower with sweet raisins, almonds and herbs in a garlicky tahini drizzle.
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C, toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin, coriander and half the salt and roast for 25 minutes until deep golden at the edges and tender.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water and remaining salt until smooth.
Toss the warm cauliflower with the raisins, almonds and parsley and drizzle with the dressing.
notes: Roast on a single layer so the florets brown rather than steam.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Roast Carrot Salad with Harissa Yoghurt and Pistachios
recipes.summary: Sweet roast carrots on cooling harissa yoghurt with mint and crushed pistachios.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C, toss the carrots with the oil, cumin and a pinch of salt and roast for 30 minutes until tender and charred at the edges.
Mix the yoghurt with the harissa, lemon juice and remaining salt.
Spread the yoghurt on a platter, top with the warm carrots, drizzle with the honey and scatter with pistachios and mint.
notes: Use less harissa for a milder yoghurt.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Spring Pea and Edamame Salad with Mint and Feta
recipes.summary: A bright, fresh salad of peas, edamame and cucumber with mint, lemon and feta.
steps: Simmer the peas and edamame in boiling water for 3 minutes until tender and bright green, then drain and cool in cold water.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, honey and salt together.
Toss the peas, edamame, cucumber and spring onions with the dressing, then fold in the mint and feta.
notes: Dress just before serving to keep the colour bright.
Keeps 1 day in the fridge.

recipes.title: Winter Red Cabbage and Pear Slaw
recipes.summary: Crunchy red cabbage with pear, walnuts and a light cider mustard dressing.
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, honey and salt until emulsified.
Toss the cabbage, pears, carrot and parsley with the dressing.
Fold through the walnuts and let stand for 10 minutes before serving so the cabbage softens slightly.
notes: Add the pear just before serving so it stays crisp and pale.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge without the walnuts.

recipes.title: Green Beans Almondine with Lemon
recipes.summary: Crisp-tender green beans tossed with butter, toasted almonds and lemon zest.
steps: Boil the beans in salted water for 4 minutes until bright green and just tender, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pan and cook the almonds for 2 minutes until golden, then add the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toss the beans in the pan with the lemon zest, juice and salt until glossy and hot.
notes: Do not let the almonds burn once they start to colour.
Serve with fish or roast chicken.

recipes.title: Indian Aloo Jeera Cumin Potatoes
recipes.summary: Quick pan-cooked potatoes with cumin seeds, turmeric and coriander.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender and drain well.
Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the cumin seeds for 30 seconds until sizzling, then add the turmeric, chilli and ground coriander.
Add the potatoes and salt and cook for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Finish with lemon juice and fresh coriander.
notes: Drain the potatoes very well so they fry rather than steam.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Indian Jeera Rice with Whole Spices
recipes.summary: Fluffy basmati scented with cumin seeds, bay leaf and cardamom.
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a pot and fry the cumin, bay leaf and cardamom for 1 minute until sizzling and fragrant.
Add the rice, salt and water, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes until all the water is absorbed.
Rest, covered, for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
notes: Do not lift the lid while the rice cooks.
Food safety: cool leftover rice within 1 hour and refrigerate; eat within 1 day and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Chinese Egg Fried Rice with Peas and Spring Onion
recipes.summary: Quick wok-style fried rice with softly scrambled egg, sweet peas and a splash of soy.
steps: Beat the eggs, heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan and scramble the eggs for 1 minute until just set, then lift out.
Heat the remaining oil, fry the garlic and spring onion whites for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the rice and stir-fry for 4 minutes until hot and starting to crisp.
Add the peas, soy sauce, sesame oil and pepper and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the peas are hot, then fold in the egg and green spring onion.
notes: Use cold rice so the grains stay separate.
Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set; cool leftover rice within 1 hour and use within 1 day.

recipes.title: Bavarian-Style Warm Potato and Gherkin Salad
recipes.summary: A South German potato salad dressed with warm broth, vinegar and mustard.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 18 to 20 minutes until tender, drain, then peel while warm and slice.
Heat the stock with the onion, vinegar, mustard, sugar, salt and pepper for 3 minutes until the onion softens, then whisk in the oil.
Pour the warm dressing over the potatoes, toss gently and leave for 10 minutes to absorb, then fold in the chives and gherkins.
notes: Slice the potatoes while still warm so they drink in the dressing.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Hasselback Potatoes with Garlic and Thyme
recipes.summary: Fan-cut potatoes roasted until crisp at the edges and soft in the middle, with garlic and thyme.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut thin slits across each potato about 3mm apart, stopping before the base, using two chopsticks as guides.
Brush with the oil, tuck garlic slices into some slits and sprinkle with thyme, salt and pepper.
Roast for 50 to 55 minutes, basting once, until the edges are crisp and golden and the centres are soft when pierced.
notes: Chopsticks either side of the potato stop the knife cutting all the way through.
Serve straight away while crisp.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Smoked Paprika and Lime
recipes.summary: Crisp roast sweet potato wedges with smoked paprika, finished with lime and a cooling yoghurt dip.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and toss the wedges with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Roast on a lined tray, turning once, for 30 to 35 minutes until crisp at the edges and tender inside.
Stir the lime juice and coriander into the yoghurt and serve alongside.
notes: Leave space between the wedges so they crisp.
Eat the same day for best crunch.

recipes.title: Peruvian Papa a la Huancaina with Boiled Egg
recipes.summary: Sliced potatoes under a creamy cheese and chilli sauce, a Peruvian classic.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 18 to 20 minutes until tender, and boil the eggs for 9 minutes until firm, then cool both.
Blend the feta, evaporated milk, lime juice, chilli, bread, oil and salt until smooth and creamy.
Peel and slice the potatoes, arrange on lettuce, spoon over the sauce and top with halved eggs and olives.
notes: The sauce thickens as it chills; thin with a splash of milk.
Food safety: boil eggs until firm and eat within 1 day if keeping.
